# Generated by tools/cm_generate_town_rights_map_mode.py - do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate after a game update.

# Slot entries resolve rank k to a line, or to nothing: cm_trmm_slot_* for the
# ranked rights list, cm_trmm_bd_slot_* for the same ranking with per-industry
# sub-lines, cm_trmm_ind_slot_* for the industries ranked by coverage.
# The cm_uright_rank_slot and cm_uright_rank_bd_slot copies are identical but
# point at line keys that read the location from the customizable-loc target, so
# the build-location marker can reuse the ranking tooltip where the window root
# is not the row's location.

# Inline RGO chips on the dyes/wine industry lines: shown when the location's
# own raw material is the good, whose RGO averages the displayed value up.
cm_trmm_rgo_chip_dyes = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			raw_material ?= goods:dyes
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_chip_rgo_dyes
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_rgo_chip_wine = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			raw_material ?= goods:wine
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_chip_rgo_wine
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
# Comma-joined "tied with" list per right: cm_trmm_tie_prefix_* shows the
# shared static label when at least one other right ties, and
# cm_trmm_tie_item_<right>_<other> resolves to that other right's name (with a
# leading comma unless it is the first tied item in priority order), or nothing.
cm_trmm_tie_prefix_tooling = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_tie_count_tooling > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tied_with_prefix
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_tie_prefix_jewelry = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_tie_count_jewelry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_tied_with_prefix
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

# Build-location urban-right marker icons: cm_uright_rec_icon resolves the
# recommended right (rank 0), cm_uright_assigned_icon the single granted royal
# right, each to that right's texticon. cm_uright_assigned_item_* is the
# per-right granted-or-blank line the multi-right hover list and the
# search-mode stripe-reason line concatenate.
cm_uright_rec_icon = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_tooling = 0
			cm_trmm_right_tooling > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_jewelry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_jewelry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_naval = 0
			cm_trmm_right_naval > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_textile = 0
			cm_trmm_right_textile > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_weaponry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_weaponry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_book = 0
			cm_trmm_right_book > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_artisan = 0
			cm_trmm_right_artisan > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_brewing = 0
			cm_trmm_right_brewing > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			cm_trmm_rank_masonry = 0
			cm_trmm_right_masonry > 0
		}
		localization_key = cm_uright_icon_line_masonry
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

# Stripe-reason lines for the map mode tooltips' bottom:
# cm_trmm_stripe_reason explains the main mode's stripe (the granted
# right's fit tier, the tied rights, or the open urban right slot),
# cm_trmm_search_reason_* the reason for the search modes' stripe.
# Blocks mirror the stripe limits, so first match = stripe precedence.
cm_trmm_stripe_reason = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 8
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 7
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 6
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 5
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 4
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 3
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 2
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 1
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_best_masonry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
			cm_trmm_right_tooling >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
			cm_trmm_right_jewelry >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
			cm_trmm_right_naval >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
			cm_trmm_right_textile >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
			cm_trmm_right_weaponry >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
			cm_trmm_right_book >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
			cm_trmm_right_artisan >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
			cm_trmm_right_brewing >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
			cm_trmm_right_masonry >= 0.5
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_good_masonry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_poor_masonry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_tooling
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 8
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_jewelry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 7
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_naval
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 6
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_textile
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 5
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_weaponry
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 4
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_book
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 3
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_artisan
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_tie_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 2
			var:cm_trmm_tie_idx >= 1
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_tied_brewing
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_max_town_rights = no
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_reason_open_slot
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
cm_trmm_search_reason_tooling = {
	type = location
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_tooling_rights
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_granted_line
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			var:cm_trmm_best_idx = 9
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_best_line
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_jewelry_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_naval_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_textile_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_weaponry_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_book_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_artisan_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_brewing_rights
				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
			}
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_other_line
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_max_town_rights = no
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_open_slot_line
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}

				has_town_rights = town_rights_type:royal_masonry_rights
			}
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_other_line
	}
	text = {
		trigger = {
			has_max_town_rights = no
		}
		localization_key = cm_trmm_search_open_slot_line
	}
	text = {
		localization_key = cm_trmm_blank
		fallback = yes
	}
}
